body: The hold remains. cand-08 is necessary but not sufficient: surface-analyze is arbitrary-text CLI intake, which the current StoryAtlas summary keeps gated by Stage 1b, while any custodial self-contained output also depends on the broader output contract. Do not create a sibling role, bead, reservation, or implementation yet. You may prepare only a read-only source-plus-artifact inspector acceptance matrix. Revisit implementation after Stage 1b and the output successor land and StoryAtlas can pin an immutable storymodel SHA.
